first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The figure in the center with their back to the camera, wearing a dark brown top and a light-colored hanging cloth, with a long yellow-ochre cloth strip hanging at the waist and carrying a round shield and longbow on their back.

entities.name: stone passageway
entities.identification: The light pinkish-beige walkable stone platform surfaces at the lower and upper ends of the stone steps.

entities.name: cage brazier
entities.identification: The group of black, openwork cage braziers beside the passageway, with their positions distinguished by the nearby fence corner and the distant long passageway.

entities.name: stone steps
entities.identification: The broad, light-colored, straight stone steps connecting the two platform levels, together with their thick side walls.

entities.name: wooden stake fence
entities.identification: The fence along the outer edge of the passageway, made of closely spaced, slender gray-brown wooden stakes with horizontal connecting poles.

entities.name: wood-roofed courtyard
entities.identification: The low courtyard visible behind the transverse fence in the latter part, with thin wooden poles and a roof of orange-brown covering panels.

entities.name: tower-wall complex
entities.identification: The complex composed of a distant reddish-brown tall tower, long wall, square gateway pillars, and an open upper canopy frame.

entities.name: stone building complex
entities.identification: The light pinkish-brown thick walls, flat roofs, and tower-like settlement buildings on both sides of the stone steps and in the distance.

entities.name: layered rock face
entities.identification: The light ochre to reddish-brown rock face and terrace with horizontal stratification in the distant upper-left background in the latter part.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The light grayish-white to light yellowish-gray sky visible between the buildings and the distant terrain.

entities.name: vegetation
entities.identification: The collection of plants outside the passageway, including thin-branched shrubs, clumps of grass, broad-canopied trees, and palms.

entities.name: sandy ground
entities.identification: The exposed light yellowish-brown ground at a lower elevation outside the elevated passageway.

entities.name: domed stone parapet wall
entities.identification: The thick, light pinkish-beige parapet wall beside the passageway, topped by repeated rounded stone blocks and with recessed frames on its front.

entities.name: longbow
entities.identification: The slender yellowish-brown curved bow hanging diagonally behind Person A, with visible sections extending above the shoulder and toward the waist.

entities.name: round shield
entities.identification: The dark greenish-black, nearly circular shield on Person A's back, with light-colored curled decoration.

entities.name: woven mat
entities.identification: The large gray-brown mat on the stone surface toward the lower right in frame 0, with densely arranged parallel thin strips across its surface.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: A gray-brown horse beside a wooden shelter in the lowland on the right in the latter part, shown side-on with its head toward image-left and lighter-colored legs.
